description: Routing evals: does the query ask for a live picture of what is trending in software from public sources (GitHub trending and new repos, Hacker News, Lobsters)? Near-misses route to deep-research (one topic in depth), repo-status, get-work and work-status (the user's own repos and work), and github-insights (profile metrics).

queries.query: give me the top 20 trending repos this week
any new rust repos blowing up this month
what's on hacker news right now
catch me up on tech news without me opening twitter
queries.note: Full digest; state that X is not a source.

queries.query: what are people in the agent tooling space shipping lately
what's happening on twitter and github
queries.note: Digest; HN and Lobsters stand in for X.

queries.query: research how vector databases compare for a 10M row workload
what's the status of my repos
what PRs do I have open
what should I work on next across my projects
generate the stars and languages card for my github profile
star that trending repo and clone it
queries.note: A write action; trending is read-only.

queries.query: is the tokio crate still maintained
queries.note: A lookup about one project, not a trend digest.
